answer: An agent economy can resist sybil floods by scoring each identity as a vertex in a work graph, not a countable key. Attestations only count when they arrive from separate groves — clusters of agents whose own histories share no recent co-signers — so a farm cannot mint weight by endorsing its clones. A newcomer stays at zero payout and vote share until its record crosses a ridge: k such independent groves have verified distinct epoch answers and attestations. Split or recycled keys start with empty grove membership, which makes buying a mass of shells more expensive than doing the work once.
